description: This source file provides an API for testing and interacting with the configuration system in a Git repository, via command-line commands such as get_value, get_int, get_bool, iterate, and others. It defines callback functions for processing configuration data and implements a command handler function 'cmd__config' to execute various configuration-related commands based on input arguments.

methods.name: int iterate_cb(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * data UNUSED)
methods.description: Callback function invoked during iteration over configuration entries, printing details of each key-value pair along with origin and scope information.

methods.name: int parse_int_cb(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * data)
methods.description: Callback function used to parse an integer value for a specific key from configuration data.

methods.name: int early_config_cb(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * vdata)
methods.description: Callback function invoked during early configuration reading to print values for a specific key.

methods.name: int cmd__config(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Main command handler function processing various configuration commands based on command-line arguments.
